activity.notes: Representative mid-fifth-century BCE Athenian activity point. The surviving biographical tradition securely places Aspasia in Athens and associates her with Pericles, but many detailed intellectual and political claims are contested; the point avoids encoding a synthetic continuous career.

sources.title: 1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica — Aspasia
sources.citation_text: The Britannica article places Aspasia in fifth-century BCE Athens, where she gained a reputation for her accomplishments and became Pericles' partner.
